title: 1885 – Kinh thành Huế và chiếu Cần Vương
voiceNote: vibi.pro, giọng Tuấn Anh = ElevenLabs HG0MlJIknmaXREpTckfK, eleven_v3, stability 0.5, speed 1, lời từ tts-ngat-nhip.txt

ham-nghi.name: Vua Hàm Nghi
ham-nghi.look: a young Vietnamese emperor, short and slim, youthful round face, calm serious eyes, bright yellow imperial robe with a simple round dragon outline on the chest (no characters), small yellow wrapped turban, black cloth shoes

ton-that-thuyet.name: Tôn Thất Thuyết
ton-that-thuyet.look: a stern Vietnamese Nguyen dynasty regent and general aged about 46, big sturdy body, dark tanned square face, thick black eyebrows, short black mustache and short black beard, fierce eyes, black wrapped turban, vermilion red silk court robe with wide sleeves, wide black belt, a sheathed sword at his side

nguyen-van-tuong.name: Nguyễn Văn Tường
nguyen-van-tuong.look: a Vietnamese Nguyen dynasty regent mandarin aged about 59, thin, long narrow face, thin grey mustache and small grey goatee, narrow cautious eyes, black wrapped turban, teal blue silk court robe with wide sleeves, holding a closed folding fan

harmand.name: Hác-măng (Harmand)
harmand.look: a French colonial civil commissioner aged about 38, slim, pale face, neat brown mustache and small pointed brown beard, arrogant smug expression, black frock coat, white shirt, black bow tie, black top hat

de-courcy.name: Đờ Cuốc-xi (De Courcy)
de-courcy.look: a French army general aged about 58, stout with a round belly, red cheeks, big bushy white walrus mustache, dark navy blue general's tunic with gold buttons and gold embroidered cuffs, dark blue kepi with gold braid, red trousers, a sword at his side

tu-duc.name: Vua Tự Đức
tu-duc.look: a frail elderly Vietnamese emperor aged about 54, pale thin face, thin black mustache, tired kind eyes, pale yellow imperial robe, pale yellow wrapped turban

truong-quang-ngoc.name: Trương Quang Ngọc
truong-quang-ngoc.look: a Vietnamese mountain chieftain aged about 30, lean, shifty eyes glancing sideways, thin black mustache, dark indigo tunic, black head wrap, red waist sash, a short knife at his belt

linh-phap.name: Lính Pháp 1880 (hình tượng)
linh-phap.look: a French marine soldier of the 1880s, European man with a brown mustache, white cork sun helmet, dark navy blue tunic with brass buttons, white trousers, rifle with a long bayonet

quan-ta.name: Lính triều Nguyễn (hình tượng)
quan-ta.look: a Vietnamese Nguyen dynasty soldier of the 1880s, slim young man, small pointed lacquered conical hat with a brass tip, short red tunic with dark blue borders and a plain round white patch on the chest without characters, black trousers, barefoot, holding a long spear

scenes.narration: Rạng sáng hôm ấy, giữa tiếng súng, một cậu bé mười ba tuổi được đưa ra khỏi kinh thành Huế.
scenes.image: Night before dawn, low camera angle in front of the Cua Huu (south-west gate) of the Hue citadel: a thick old brick and stone citadel wall with ONE big round-arched gate tunnel, on top of the wall above the arch a small single-storey wooden watchtower pavilion with a curved yellow tiled roof, and set into the wall directly above the arch a large horizontal dark red wooden name plaque with a gold border that is COMPLETELY BLANK. Behind the wall the sky glows orange with fire, gunfire flashes and grey smoke rise. Out of the arch, large in the frame and walking toward the viewer, the red-robed regent firmly leads the young emperor by the hand, both glancing back worried. Burning torches on both sides of the arch, a few small palace guards with spears in the background, dark stone pavement with orange reflections in the foreground, the edge of a red lacquered pillar framing the left side

scenes.narration: Cậu không mang theo ngai vàng, cũng chẳng mang theo kho báu nào.
scenes.image: Low angle inside a dark Hue throne hall at night: a big empty golden throne on red lacquered steps fills the centre, moonlight beams falling through the open doors, red lacquered pillars framing both sides, orange fire glow through the lattice windows; in the foreground on the steps an open wooden chest of gold ingots left behind and a fallen yellow silk parasol, nobody there

scenes.narration: Thứ cậu để lại cho đất nước, chỉ là một tờ giấy.
scenes.image: Big close-up: a small hand in a bright yellow silk sleeve holds a single rolled paper scroll tied with a red cord, filling the centre of the frame, the scroll glowing softly; behind it a dark palace corridor with red lanterns and pillars, gunfire glow far away

scenes.narration: Cậu bé ấy là một vị vua. Vị vua ấy là Hàm Nghi.
scenes.image: Waist-up portrait of the young emperor facing the viewer, filling most of the frame, calm serious face, inside a Hue palace hall with red lacquered pillars, carved golden wooden screens, hanging red paper lanterns and a polished tiled floor in perspective, a golden throne and golden screen behind him, warm candlelight from both sides

scenes.narration: Ba năm sau, cậu bị bắt, rồi bị đày sang tận châu Phi, không bao giờ trở về.
scenes.image: The young emperor (now wearing a plain dark brown tunic instead of the robe), waist-up and large in the foreground, holds the wet rail of an old steamship and looks back sadly; ropes, a lifebuoy and a smoking black funnel frame the shot; behind him a stormy grey-green sea and a misty coastline with mountains far away, seagulls

scenes.narration: Vì sao một vị vua lại bỏ ngai vàng để vào rừng? Và một tờ giấy, thì làm được gì trước đại bác?
scenes.image: Comical contrast in a jungle clearing at sunset: the young emperor stands in the centre, puzzled, with a sweat drop; on his left on a tree stump lies a tiny rolled paper scroll, on his right a huge black French cannon towers over him; dense bamboo and banana trees behind, orange sunset light
scenes.title: VÌ SAO VUA BỎ NGAI VÀNG?

scenes.narration: Ở tập trước, quân Pháp đã chiếm thành Hà Nội, và chiến thuyền của họ đang tiến về cửa biển Thuận An, sát nách kinh thành.
scenes.image: an aged parchment map in flat cartoon style filling the whole frame, lying on a dark wooden table, simple ink coastline and rivers, green hills, an oil lamp and an ink brush at the edges, no labels, no text, no letters: the coast of central Vietnam with a lagoon river mouth and a square walled citadel a little inland, several small French steam warships with black smoke drawn at sea in the lower right. Nobody in the scene: no people, no figures, no soldiers, no faces

scenes.narration: Hôm nay, hãy cùng Vy đi nốt chặng cuối của câu chuyện này nhé, về kinh thành Huế những năm tháng sóng gió nhất.
scenes.image: Grand view of the Hue citadel at sunrise: the Ngo Mon gate with its two-storey pavilion and yellow tiled roofs fills the upper half, in front the wide Perfume River with small sampans and a dragon boat, flowering trees and a stone embankment in the foreground; heavy dark storm clouds rolling in from the sea over the golden sunrise, birds flying away. Nobody in the scene: no people, no figures, no soldiers, no faces

scenes.narration: Tháng Bảy năm một tám tám ba, vua Tự Đức băng hà, không có con trai nối ngôi.
scenes.image: Inside a dim imperial bedchamber: the frail old emperor lies in bed under a yellow silk canopy, large in the frame, eyes peacefully closed; in the foreground the backs of kneeling mandarins in black turbans with bowed heads; tall red candles, incense smoke, gold and deep red tones, sad and solemn

scenes.narration: Chưa đầy một tháng sau, chiến thuyền Pháp nã pháo vào cửa Thuận An.
scenes.image: Low angle from the sand dunes at a river mouth: big French steam warships with tall black funnels fire their cannons, huge white smoke clouds and orange muzzle flashes; in the foreground an earthen Vietnamese fort wall with an old bronze cannon and sand flying from explosions

scenes.narration: Chỉ ba ngày, các đồn canh giữ cửa biển đã thất thủ.
scenes.image: A Vietnamese soldier large in the foreground runs back across a smoking earthen fort on the sand dunes, looking back in fear; behind him French marines climb over the broken wall with rifles; smoke, small fires, broken sandbags and a toppled old cannon

scenes.narration: Viên đại diện Pháp là Hác-măng gửi tối hậu thư, cho triều đình đúng hai mươi bốn giờ để trả lời.
scenes.image: Inside a Hue palace hall with red lacquered pillars, carved golden wooden screens, hanging red paper lanterns and a polished tiled floor in perspective: the French commissioner, large on the right, holds out a sealed letter with a red wax seal; a nervous Vietnamese mandarin in a black turban on the left with sweat drops; on the table in the foreground between them a big hourglass with sand running out

scenes.narration: Sử chép, ông ta còn đe: "Cái tên Việt Nam… sẽ bị xóa khỏi lịch sử."
scenes.image: Close-up of the French commissioner, his face filling half the frame, smug arrogant smile, pointing his finger at the viewer; behind him on the wall a big pink eraser rubbing out part of an old parchment map, lit from below by an oil lamp

scenes.narration: Triều đình đành ký hòa ước Quý Mùi, nhận sự bảo hộ của nước Pháp.
scenes.image: Signing ceremony inside a Hue palace hall with red lacquered pillars, carved golden wooden screens, hanging red paper lanterns and a polished tiled floor in perspective: in the foreground Vietnamese mandarins with sad faces sign a long document at a red lacquered table with brush and ink; the French commissioner stands large behind them with arms crossed, smug; two French soldiers guard the door

scenes.narration: Chữ "bảo hộ" nghe như được che chở. Nhưng thực ra là mất quyền tự quyết.
scenes.image: Gag in a palace courtyard in heavy rain: a big French soldier, large in the frame, with exactly two arms and two hands: his right hand holds a black umbrella tilted fully over the head of a small worried Vietnamese mandarin standing beside him, as if protecting him from the rain, while his left hand grips the back of the mandarin's collar firmly; his rifle is slung across his back with no hand on it; the soldier himself gets wet, smug smile; puddles, red pillars and a tiled roof behind

scenes.narration: Giống như một ngôi nhà vẫn treo biển tên chủ cũ, nhưng chìa khóa cửa đã nằm trong túi người khác.
scenes.image: Gag: a traditional Vietnamese wooden house with a curved tiled roof fills the frame, a blank wooden name board above the door; the Vietnamese owner in a black turban stands large in the left foreground looking at it sadly; a French officer leans in the doorway twirling a big iron key ring, smug; potted bonsai, lanterns, warm afternoon light

scenes.narration: Trong cung, ngai vàng cũng chẳng yên ổn hơn.
scenes.image: Inside a dim palace throne hall: a golden throne on red steps in the centre wobbles (small motion lines), long dark shadows of grasping hands reach toward it from both sides across the floor, red pillars framing the shot, a single beam of cold moonlight. Nobody in the scene: no people, no figures, no soldiers, no faces

scenes.narration: Chỉ trong khoảng một năm, bốn vị vua lần lượt bước lên ngai.
scenes.image: Gag still life, no people: four small yellow silk imperial turbans (soft wrapped cloth head bands with visible fabric folds, clearly cloth headwear, not fruit, not pots) each on its own small wooden hat stand on a long red lacquered shelf filling the frame; three stands knocked over with their turbans fallen, only one still upright; palace background with red pillars and a lantern
scenes.title: MỘT NĂM, BỐN VUA

scenes.narration: Vua Dục Đức ở ngôi ba ngày thì bị phế.
scenes.image: A young Vietnamese emperor of about 30 in a yellow robe, large in the frame, is escorted out of the throne hall by two palace guards gripping his arms, surprised face; on a side table in the foreground three burnt-out candles; the empty throne behind

scenes.narration: Vua Hiệp Hòa được bốn tháng, rồi bị ép uống thuốc độc.
scenes.image: Night in a dim palace room: a middle-aged Vietnamese emperor in a yellow robe sits slumped and frightened, large in the frame, while a stern official's arm holds out a small cup on a lacquered tray toward him in the foreground; one oil lamp casting long shadows

scenes.narration: Vua Kiến Phúc mới mười lăm tuổi, ở ngôi tám tháng thì qua đời.
scenes.image: A pale thin young Vietnamese emperor in a yellow robe lies sick in bed under a canopy, large in the frame, an old physician kneels feeling his pulse; a steaming medicine bowl in the foreground, dim candlelight, worried servants in the background

scenes.narration: Đứng sau những lần thay vua ấy, là hai vị phụ chính: Nguyễn Văn Tường và Tôn Thất Thuyết.
scenes.image: Low angle: the two regents stand side by side, knee-up and large, behind an empty golden throne, one in teal and one in red, looking down sternly at the viewer, inside a Hue palace hall with red lacquered pillars, carved golden wooden screens, hanging red paper lanterns and a polished tiled floor in perspective

scenes.narration: Chỗ này sử chép khác nhau, Vy nói cả hai.
scenes.image: An open old book with blank pages fills the frame, lying on a scholar's desk; the left half of the background is sunny and calm with blossoms, the right half dark and stormy with lightning; an ink brush and ink stone in the foreground

scenes.narration: Có người bảo họ chuyên quyền, đặt vua lên rồi nhấc xuống như những quân cờ.
scenes.image: Gag: two giant hands from above, one in a red sleeve and one in a teal sleeve, place small emperor figurines in yellow robes on a big chessboard that fills the frame like chess pieces; one figurine already knocked over; palace floor around

scenes.narration: Có người lại cho rằng, họ đang tìm một ông vua dám đứng lên chống Pháp.
scenes.image: The red-robed regent stands large in the foreground at an open palace window seen from behind his shoulder, fist clenched, determined angry eyebrows, watching French warships with smoking funnels on the Perfume River outside; wooden lattice frames the shot

scenes.narration: Năm một tám tám bốn, triều đình lại phải ký thêm hòa ước Giáp Thân.
scenes.image: Inside a palace pavilion: Vietnamese mandarins in black turbans sign papers at a red lacquered table in the foreground, reluctant; a French diplomat in a black frock coat, white shirt and black bow tie, grey mustache, bare head (no hat) stands over them pointing at the paper; red pillars and lanterns

scenes.narration: Chiếc ấn mà nhà Thanh phong cho vua Nguyễn bị đem nấu chảy, ngay trước mặt sứ thần Pháp.
scenes.image: A square metal seal with a small crouching lion on top (no characters on it) melts in a small glowing furnace in the foreground, flames and sparks; a French diplomat in a black frock coat, white shirt and black bow tie, grey mustache, bare head (no hat) watches smugly with arms crossed; Vietnamese mandarins in black turbans watch sadly in the background

scenes.narration: Từ đây, Đại Nam chỉ còn một ông chủ đứng sau lưng: nước Pháp.
scenes.image: Gag: a huge dark silhouette of a French officer in a kepi stands behind a small golden Vietnamese throne, holding puppet strings attached to it, inside a red palace hall lit by a single lamp

scenes.narration: Tháng Tám năm ấy, một cậu bé mười ba tuổi được đưa lên ngai vàng: vua Hàm Nghi.
scenes.image: Coronation: low angle, the young emperor sits on a big golden throne, large in the frame, his feet not touching the floor, looking small and serious; rows of mandarins kneeling below in the foreground; golden light, red pillars, incense smoke, yellow parasols
scenes.title: HÀM NGHI

scenes.narration: Cậu vốn sống ngoài cung, quen cảnh thường dân, chưa từng nghĩ mình sẽ làm vua.
scenes.image: Warm sunny flashback: the young emperor (wearing plain brown commoner clothes instead of the robe) carries a bucket of water, large in the frame, in front of a humble village house with a thatched roof, a bamboo fence, chickens and banana trees

scenes.narration: Người đứng cạnh cậu, là Tôn Thất Thuyết.
scenes.image: The red-robed regent stands large beside the young emperor's golden throne with his hand on his sword hilt, protective and stern, the young emperor seated; inside a Hue palace hall with red lacquered pillars, carved golden wooden screens, hanging red paper lanterns and a polished tiled floor in perspective

scenes.narration: Ông là người cầm đầu phe chủ chiến trong triều.
scenes.image: War council at night: the red-robed regent leans over a big map spread on a table in the foreground, pointing; mandarins in black turbans lean in around the table and nod; one oil lamp lights their faces from below, dark room

scenes.narration: Ngoài mặt, ông vẫn tiếp đón sứ Pháp. Nhưng sau lưng, ông lặng lẽ chuẩn bị.
scenes.image: Split composition: the red-robed regent bows politely to a French diplomat in a black frock coat, white shirt and black bow tie, grey mustache, bare head (no hat), but behind his back his hand grips his sword hilt (shown clearly in the foreground); palace courtyard with red pillars

scenes.narration: Ông lập những đội quân riêng, lấy tên là Phấn Nghĩa.
scenes.image: Training ground in front of palace walls: the red-robed regent stands large in the foreground with arms crossed; behind him rows of young Vietnamese soldiers practise thrusting spears in a diagonal line, dust, flags without writing

scenes.narration: Ông cho tích trữ lương thực, súng đạn, chuyển bớt vàng bạc ra khỏi kinh thành.
scenes.image: Night: workers carry wooden chests and sacks of rice onto ox carts out of a palace side gate, lit by red lanterns; one worker large in the foreground puts a finger to his lips, secretive mood

scenes.narration: Và ông bí mật dựng một căn cứ giữa núi rừng Quảng Trị: sơn phòng Tân Sở.
scenes.image: a jungle mountain fortress: a tall wooden palisade gate with two small watchtowers, thatched barracks and earthen walls among dense green jungle, misty mountains behind, seen from the path in front of the gate; the gate fills the upper half and above the gate hangs a large horizontal wooden name board that is COMPLETELY BLANK; soldiers with spears at the gate, torches, ferns in the foreground

scenes.narration: Nghe thì như một triều đình đã cúi đầu. Nhưng thực ra, họ chỉ đang chờ thời cơ.
scenes.image: The red-robed regent kneels, large in the frame, with his head bowed politely, but his eyes glance up sideways sharply with a small secret smile; palace floor and red pillars behind

scenes.narration: Đầu tháng Bảy năm một tám tám lăm, tướng Pháp Đờ Cuốc-xi kéo quân tới Huế.
scenes.image: The French general on horseback, large in the foreground, leads a long column of French marines along the Perfume River toward the walls of the Hue citadel; banana trees and the riverbank, afternoon light

scenes.narration: Ông ta muốn ra oai với triều đình, và tính chuyện bắt Tôn Thất Thuyết.
scenes.image: The French general sits smugly in a carved armchair, large in the frame, hiding a pair of iron handcuffs behind his back (shown clearly); a French colonial office with a desk, papers and a French flag

scenes.narration: Tương truyền, Đờ Cuốc-xi còn đòi dẫn quân đi qua cửa giữa Ngọ Môn, lối đi chỉ dành riêng cho nhà vua.
scenes.image: Symmetrical frontal view of the Ngo Mon gate of the Hue imperial citadel: a massive brick gate base with a big arched middle door and smaller side doors, topped by a two-storey wooden pavilion with yellow glazed tiled curved roofs, and directly above the middle door a large horizontal dark red wooden name plaque with a gold border that is COMPLETELY BLANK; the gate fills the upper half of the frame, warm late afternoon light. In front of the middle door, large in the frame, the French general on a horse arrogantly points at the big middle door, which glows golden. In the foreground lower corners Vietnamese mandarins in teal and red robes turn their heads, shocked, sweat drops. Red flags and bronze cauldrons along the stone courtyard

scenes.narration: Tôn Thất Thuyết cáo ốm, không đến buổi tiếp.
scenes.image: The red-robed regent lies in bed pretending to be sick, large in the frame, a wet cloth on his forehead, one eye open slyly; his sword leaning on the bed, a teapot on a side table, wooden bedroom

scenes.narration: Ông hiểu, chờ thêm nữa, là chờ người ta đến bắt mình.
scenes.image: Night: the red-robed regent sits up in bed, large in the frame, a thought bubble above him showing French soldiers coming with handcuffs; lantern light, dark wooden room

scenes.narration: Đánh thì chưa chắc thắng. Không đánh thì chắc chắn mất tất cả.
scenes.image: Extreme close-up: the regent's face fills more than half the frame, split lighting, the left half lit warm red-orange by a red paper lantern at the frame edge, the right half in deep blue shadow, a single drop of sweat, hard determined eyes; dark palace pillars behind
scenes.title: ĐÁNH HAY CHỜ?

scenes.narration: Ông chọn đánh trước.
scenes.image: Night: the red-robed regent stands up and draws his sword, knee-up and large in the frame, determined; a lantern glowing behind him, an open door to the dark courtyard

scenes.narration: Rạng sáng ngày năm tháng Bảy năm một tám tám lăm, một tiếng súng lệnh vang lên giữa đêm.
scenes.image: Night on the citadel wall: a big signal cannon in the foreground fires into the dark sky, a bright yellow flash and white smoke; a Vietnamese gunner covers his ears; a red flag without writing on the battlement

scenes.narration: Quân ta đồng loạt đánh vào tòa Khâm sứ và đồn Mang Cá, nơi quân Pháp đóng.
scenes.image: Night attack, camera placed BEHIND the whole Vietnamese army: EVERY soldier is seen from the back, we only see their backs, red tunics and the backs of their conical hats, NO faces visible at all, nobody looks back or turns toward the camera; all of them run in the same direction, away from the viewer, toward a burning enemy building across a river; the nearest soldier, large in the lower foreground seen from behind, raises a blazing torch and thrusts his spear forward; in front of him a crowd of soldiers (all backs) rushes down the riverbank and wades into the shallow water, torches and spears raised, fire arrows arcing through the night sky toward the building; in the upper part of the frame, across the river, a two-storey European colonial building with a French flag is on fire, orange smoke rising into a deep blue night sky; torchlight reflected on the water; aggressive forward attack

scenes.narration: Lửa bốc cháy khắp hai bờ sông Hương.
scenes.image: Night: fires burning along both banks of the Perfume River, roofs of houses aflame, orange reflections on the water, a small sampan in the foreground, black smoke, no bridge

scenes.narration: Nhưng quân Pháp giữ được trận địa. Trời vừa sáng, họ phản công.
scenes.image: Dawn: French marines kneel behind sandbag barricades firing rifles toward the viewer, the front marine large in the foreground, smoke and pale morning light

scenes.narration: Một lần nữa, súng trường và đại bác lại nói lời quyết định.
scenes.image: Dawn, inside the Hue citadel, camera placed BEHIND a French field cannon: the cannon is large in the lower foreground seen from behind, its barrel pointing STRAIGHT AWAY from the viewer into the distance, a bright muzzle flash and a big white smoke cloud bursting from the FRONT end of the barrel; two French gunners beside it seen from behind and the side, one covering his ears, one holding the rammer; in the distance ahead, beyond the smoke, a thick old brick citadel wall and palace roofs burning with black smoke; small Vietnamese soldiers far away retreat and run AWAY from the cannon toward the wall, their backs to the viewer, some carrying a wounded comrade, no blood; pale grey-orange dawn sky; the French clearly winning

scenes.narration: Kinh thành thất thủ. Cung điện bị cướp phá, vô số người dân chết trong khói lửa.
scenes.image: Palace buildings burning with black smoke; French soldiers in the foreground carry away golden vases and wooden chests, one grinning; broken lanterns on the ground

scenes.narration: Đến hôm nay, người Huế vẫn lấy ngày hai mươi ba tháng Năm âm lịch, làm ngày giỗ chung.
scenes.image: Evening in an old Hue street: a family kneels in the foreground at their home altar lighting incense, soft smoke curling; other houses with lit altars down the street, lanterns, solemn warm light

scenes.narration: Trong lúc hỗn loạn, Tôn Thất Thuyết đưa vua Hàm Nghi và Tam cung ra khỏi thành.
scenes.image: Smoky dawn, in front of the Cua Huu (south-west gate) of the Hue citadel: a thick old brick and stone citadel wall with ONE big round-arched gate tunnel, on top of the wall above the arch a small single-storey wooden watchtower pavilion with a curved yellow tiled roof, and set into the wall directly above the arch a large horizontal dark red wooden name plaque with a gold border that is COMPLETELY BLANK: the red-robed regent, large in the frame, leads the young emperor and three royal ladies in long robes out of the arch, carrying bundles; soldiers with torches behind, fire glow over the wall

scenes.narration: Cậu bé mười ba tuổi bước qua cổng kinh thành. Và không bao giờ trở lại.
scenes.image: Seen from behind, over his shoulder: the young emperor walks out through a dark citadel gate tunnel toward a misty road, looking back once; through the arch behind him the palace glows orange with fire; brick tunnel walls frame the shot

scenes.narration: Đoàn người băng rừng vượt núi, ra đến Tân Sở, Quảng Trị.
scenes.image: an aged parchment map in flat cartoon style filling the whole frame, lying on a dark wooden table, simple ink coastline and rivers, green hills, an oil lamp and an ink brush at the edges, no labels, no text, no letters: central Vietnam with a square walled citadel beside a river near the coast, and green mountains to the north-west with a small hidden fort among them. Nobody in the scene: no people, no figures, no soldiers, no faces

scenes.narration: Ngày mười ba tháng Bảy năm một tám tám lăm, tại đây, một tờ chiếu được ban ra, nhân danh vua Hàm Nghi.
scenes.image: Inside a jungle fortress hall made of wood and bamboo: the red-robed regent stands large in the frame reading aloud from an unrolled yellow edict, the young emperor seated behind him; in the foreground the backs of kneeling officials and soldiers; torchlight

scenes.narration: Đó là chiếu Cần Vương. Cần Vương, nghĩa là hết lòng phò vua, giúp nước.
scenes.image: Close-up still life, no people, no hands: a long yellow silk imperial edict scroll unrolled on a red lacquered table filling the frame, its surface completely plain and blank (no writing, no characters, no marks), only one red square seal stamp near the end, rays of golden light falling on it
scenes.title: CẦN VƯƠNG

scenes.narration: Chiếu kể rõ vì sao vua phải rời kinh thành, rồi kêu gọi muôn dân đứng lên.
scenes.image: Messengers on horseback gallop out of the gate of a jungle mountain fortress: a tall wooden palisade gate with two small watchtowers, thatched barracks and earthen walls among dense green jungle, misty mountains behind, toward the viewer and in different directions, the front rider large in the foreground holding a rolled scroll; dust and morning light

scenes.narration: Đại ý: ai có sức thì góp sức, ai có của thì góp của, ai có mưu thì góp mưu.
scenes.image: Three villagers step forward together, large in the frame: a strong farmer raising a hoe, a merchant offering a cloth bag of coins, a scholar in a black turban holding a brush and paper; a village market and a banyan tree behind, crowds watching

scenes.narration: Một tờ giấy, không bắn được viên đạn nào.
scenes.image: Comical contrast on a grassy hill: a tiny rolled paper scroll lies in the foreground beside a huge black cannon that fills most of the frame, low camera angle, clouds behind. Nobody in the scene: no people, no figures, no soldiers, no faces

scenes.narration: Nhưng nó như một tàn lửa, rơi xuống cánh đồng rơm khô.
scenes.image: Close-up: a tiny glowing ember falls onto a field of dry golden straw filling the frame, small flames starting to spread, sparks, dusk sky. Nobody in the scene: no people, no figures, no soldiers, no faces

scenes.narration: Từ Thanh Hóa, Nghệ An, Hà Tĩnh, đến Quảng Nam, Quảng Ngãi, Bình Định, văn thân, sĩ phu và dân thường lần lượt đứng lên.
scenes.image: Sunrise over mountains and rice fields: a crowd of scholars in black turbans and peasants with spears and hoes rise up and march toward the viewer under plain red banners without writing, the front marchers large in the foreground, more groups on the hills behind

scenes.narration: Ở Hà Tĩnh, cụ Phan Đình Phùng cầm quân suốt mười năm giữa núi rừng Hương Khê.
scenes.image: An old scholar-general with a long white beard, black turban and dark blue robe, waist-up and large in the frame, commands his troops in a mountain forest, pointing ahead; soldiers with old guns and spears behind him among big trees, mist
scenes.title: PHAN ĐÌNH PHÙNG

scenes.narration: Ở Thanh Hóa, Đinh Công Tráng dựng chiến lũy Ba Đình giữa đồng chiêm trũng.
scenes.image: A fortified village surrounded by flooded rice fields, thick bamboo hedges and earthen walls; at the village gate a large horizontal wooden name board that is COMPLETELY BLANK; defenders with spears and old guns on the walls; the front defender large in the foreground

scenes.narration: Ngọn lửa Cần Vương cháy suốt hơn mười năm.
scenes.image: Night: many beacon fires lighting up one after another on hills across a long landscape; in the foreground a watchman lights a big beacon fire with a torch, sparks flying

scenes.narration: Còn vua Hàm Nghi, ông cùng nghĩa quân ẩn mình trong núi rừng Quảng Bình, suốt ba năm.
scenes.image: The young emperor (wearing a brown jungle tunic and a headscarf instead of the robe) sits large in the frame with a small band of loyal soldiers in a thatched hut deep in a rainy jungle; rain falls outside the open side, a small cooking fire

scenes.narration: Năm một tám tám tám, vì có kẻ phản bội, ông bị bắt.
scenes.image: Night: French soldiers with lanterns surround a small thatched hut in the jungle, the front soldier large in the foreground raising his rifle; big leaves frame the shot, moonlight

scenes.narration: Kẻ dẫn quân Pháp tới, là Trương Quang Ngọc, người từng theo hầu bên vua.
scenes.image: Night jungle path: the shifty traitor, large in the foreground, leads French soldiers along the path, pointing ahead and looking back nervously; lanterns and big leaves

scenes.narration: Sử chép, vua nói: "Mi giết ta đi… còn hơn là mi mang ta ra nộp cho Tây."
scenes.image: The young emperor (in a brown jungle tunic instead of the robe) stands defiantly and points angrily at the traitor, who flinches and looks away in shame; both large in the frame, jungle clearing, French soldiers in the background

scenes.narration: Người Pháp đày ông sang An-giê, ở tận Bắc Phi, khi ông mới mười bảy tuổi.
scenes.image: An old steamship arrives at a white North African harbour city with domes, minarets and palm trees, bright sun; on the deck in the foreground a young Vietnamese man in a dark tunic looks at the strange city with a sad face

scenes.narration: Ông sống nơi đất khách hơn năm mươi năm, và trở thành một họa sĩ, ký tên Tử Xuân.
scenes.image: An older Vietnamese man with a neat black beard, wearing a dark Western suit, paints at an easel, knee-up and large in the frame, in a sunny garden with palm trees, white houses and bougainvillea

scenes.narration: Ông vẽ rất nhiều cảnh trời, mây, núi, sông. Nhưng chưa một lần được trở về quê hương.
scenes.image: Close-up: a painting on an easel showing sky, clouds, mountains and a river fills the frame, an old man's hand holding a brush in front of it, a single tear drop falling; window light

scenes.narration: Vậy, vì sao một vị vua lại bỏ ngai vàng để vào rừng?
scenes.image: The young emperor stands at a fork in the road, large in the frame: one way leads to a golden palace with a throne, the other way into a dark jungle path; he looks toward the jungle

scenes.narration: Bởi khi đất nước không còn là của mình, thì ngai vàng ấy cũng chỉ là một chiếc ghế.
scenes.image: Symbolic still life: an empty golden throne half transformed into a plain old wooden chair, in the centre of an empty dark palace hall, one beam of light from above, dust in the air. Nobody in the scene: no people, no figures, no soldiers, no faces

scenes.narration: Còn một tờ giấy làm được gì trước đại bác? Nó không thắng được trận nào. Nhưng nó giữ cho ngọn lửa không tắt.
scenes.image: Close-up: a small flame in an old lantern in the centre, protected from wind and rain by many hands of different people around it (farmer, scholar, soldier, old woman), rain falling, warm glow on the hands

scenes.narration: Hác-măng từng đe, cái tên Việt Nam sẽ bị xóa khỏi lịch sử. Nó đã không bị xóa.
scenes.image: Gag still life, top-down view, no people, no hands: a big pink rubber eraser broken into two pieces with small crumbs, lying on an old parchment map of an S-shaped coastline on a wooden desk filling the frame; the map is completely intact, nothing erased, no labels

scenes.narration: Ngọn lửa Cần Vương cháy thêm hơn mười năm, rồi lụi dần.
scenes.image: Dusk on a lonely hilltop: a big beacon fire that once blazed is burning down to low glowing embers and thin smoke, fills the lower half of the frame, a broken plain red banner without writing lying beside it, misty mountains and a fading orange sky behind. Nobody in the scene: no people, no figures, no soldiers, no faces

scenes.narration: Nhưng tờ giấy năm ấy, đã kịp đến tay một chàng thư sinh chưa đầy hai mươi tuổi ở Nghệ An.
scenes.image: Night in a humble thatched village house in Nghe An: a a thin Vietnamese young scholar aged about 19, sharp bright eyes, determined face, black wrapped turban, plain dark indigo scholar robe sits large in the frame at a low wooden table reading a copy of a long yellow edict scroll by the light of one oil lamp, his eyes burning with determination; the scroll surface is plain with no writing; old books and a brush on the table, a bamboo window with a dark village outside

scenes.narration: Anh rủ bạn học lập một đội quân nhỏ để hưởng ứng. Đội quân ấy tan rất nhanh. Còn chàng trai, thì không bỏ cuộc.
scenes.image: Rainy hillside at dawn: the a thin Vietnamese young scholar aged about 19, sharp bright eyes, determined face, black wrapped turban, plain dark indigo scholar robe stands alone, knee-up and large in the frame, soaked, fists clenched, staring at the horizon with unbroken determination; behind him on the ground lie abandoned bamboo spears and a torn plain red banner without writing, his fellow students walking away in the distance

scenes.narration: Anh là ai?
scenes.image: Mysterious close-up: the face of a a thin Vietnamese young scholar aged about 19, sharp bright eyes, determined face, black wrapped turban, plain dark indigo scholar robe fills the frame, half lit warm by an oil lamp at the frame edge and half in deep shadow, eyes looking straight at the viewer, serious and thoughtful; dark background with a faint glow
scenes.title: ANH LÀ AI?

scenes.narration: Và ở Quảng Nam, cha của một cậu bé trạc tuổi vua Hàm Nghi, cũng đã theo Cần Vương.
scenes.image: Quang Nam village insurgent camp at dawn: a young Vietnamese boy in plain brown clothes, a black head wrap, practises with a long wooden staff, large in the frame, watched proudly by his father, a stern middle-aged Vietnamese commander in a dark blue robe and black turban with a sword; behind them village volunteers train with spears among coconut palms and thatched huts, plain red banners without writing

scenes.narration: Hai người ấy sẽ cầm ngọn lửa đi tiếp, nhưng không còn để "giúp vua" nữa. Một người muốn đánh đuổi giặc. Một người muốn khai sáng cho dân.
scenes.image: Close-up: an old weathered hand passes a small glowing old lantern to two young hands reaching from opposite sides, one hand in a dark indigo sleeve, the other in a white sleeve; warm golden glow on the hands, dark blue night background, symbolic

scenes.narration: Con đường nào, mới cứu được nước?
scenes.image: A road splits into two at dawn on a hill: two young Vietnamese scholars seen from behind, large in the foreground, their faces not visible, each walks down a different path: the one on the left in a dark indigo robe and black turban carries a sword and walks toward a distant battlefield with smoke and dark mountains, the one on the right in a white robe carries a book and walks toward a sunny village with a small school house; big dawn sky

scenes.narration: Cảm ơn bạn đã xem hết video. Nếu đoán được họ là ai, hãy để lại bình luận, và nhớ theo dõi Vy để không bỏ lỡ tập sau nhé.
scenes.image: Dusk on the Perfume River: an empty small wooden sampan and a glowing paper lantern drift in the foreground, the silhouette of the Ngo Mon gate with its two-storey pavilion far behind, orange and purple sky, calm and melancholic. Nobody in the scene: no people, no figures, no soldiers, no faces
